embed.title: !tappable
embed.description: Alerts for reward tappables on the map (boxes and other tappable objects that give candy, items or stardust when tapped).

fields.name: Candy
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}tappable zubat` — candy for Zubat
`{{prefix}}tappable candy:pikachu` — the same, spelled out
`{{prefix}}tappable candy` — candy for any pokemon
`{{prefix}}tappable xlcandy:pikachu` — XL candy
`{{prefix}}tappable energy:charizard` — mega energy
`amount:6` — only when at least this many are given

fields.name: Items — use underscores for multi-word names
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}tappable rare_candy`
`{{prefix}}tappable all_items` — any item

Use `{{prefix}}info items` to see every item name the bot recognises.

fields.name: Remove
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}tappable remove zubat`
`{{prefix}}tappable remove everything`
`{{prefix}}untrack tappable id:<N>`
